title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 3, section 6 (Swan Lake)
heading: Swan Lake
state: Approved, but approximate: zone around the places named
sourceText:
Schedule 3 No Shooting or Hunting Areas (Section 4)
Swan Lake
6 That portion of the Province of British Columbia, in the vicinity of the Corporation of the City of Vernon, ODYD, which is contained within the following described boundaries: Those waters of Swan Lake to the maximum high water mark including all marshland adjacent to Swan Lake. [am. B.C. Regs. 109/85, s. 2 (a); 204/85, s. 1.]
sourceVersion: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026
